{{short description|Finds the sum of certain infinite series involving Bessel functions of the first kind}}

In [[mathematics]], the '''Lerche–Newberger sum rule''', or '''Newberger sum rule''', discovered by B.&nbsp;S.&nbsp;Newberger in 1982,<ref>
{{cite journal
  | last = Newberger
  | first = Barry S.
  | title = New sum rule for products of Bessel functions with application to plasma physics
  | year = 1982
  | journal = [[Journal of Mathematical Physics]]
  | volume = 23
  | issue = 7
  | pages = 1278–1281
  | doi = 10.1063/1.525510
 }}</ref><ref>
{{cite journal
  | last = Newberger
  | first = Barry S.
  | title = Erratum: New sum rule for products of Bessel functions with application to plasma physics [J. Math. Phys. '''23''', 1278 (1982)]
  | journal = [[Journal of Mathematical Physics]]
  | volume = 24
  | page = 2250
  | year = 1983
  | doi = 10.1063/1.525940
  | issue = 8
 }}
</ref><ref>
{{cite journal
  | first1 = M. | last1 = Bakker | first2 = N. M. | last2 = Temme
  | title = Sum rule for products of Bessel functions: Comments on a paper by Newberger
  | journal = [[Journal of Mathematical Physics]]
  | volume = 25 | pages = 1266–1267 
  | year = 1984 
  | doi = 10.1063/1.526282
  | issue = 5}}
</ref> finds the sum of certain [[infinite series]] involving [[Bessel function]]s <math>J_\alpha</math> [[Bessel function#Bessel functions of the first kind|of the first kind]]. 
It states that if <math>\mu</math> is any non-integer [[complex number]], <math>\gamma \in (0,1]</math>, and <math>\Re(\alpha+\beta)>-1</math>, then

:<math>\sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty\frac{(-1)^n J_{\alpha - \gamma n}(z)J_{\beta + \gamma n}(z)}{n+\mu}=\frac{\pi}{\sin \mu \pi}J_{\alpha + \gamma \mu}(z)J_{\beta - \gamma \mu}(z).</math>

Newberger's formula generalizes a formula of this type proven by Lerche in 1966. Lerche's formula has <math>\gamma=1</math>; both extend a standard rule for the summation of Bessel functions, and are useful in [[plasma (physics)|plasma]] physics.<ref>
{{cite journal
 | last = Lerche | first = I.
 | title = Transverse waves in a relativistic plasma
 | journal = [[Physics of Fluids]]
 | volume = 9 
 | issue = 6
 | pages = 1073–1080 
 | year = 1966 
 | doi = 10.1063/1.1761804
}}
</ref><ref>
{{cite journal
 | first1 = Hong | last1 = Qin | first2 = Cynthia K. | last2 = Phillips | author2-link = Cynthia Kieras Phillips | first3 = Ronald C. | last3 = Davidson
 | title = A new derivation of the plasma susceptibility tensor for a hot magnetized plasma without infinite sums of products of Bessel functions
 | journal = [[Physics of Plasmas]] | volume = 14 | page = 092103 | year = 2007 | doi = 10.1063/1.2769968
 | issue = 9}}
</ref><ref>
{{cite journal
 | first1 = I. | last1 = Lerche | first2 = R. | last2 = Schlickeiser | first3 = R. C. | last3 = Tautz
 | title = Comment on "A new derivation of the plasma susceptibility tensor for a hot magnetized plasma without infinite sums of products of Bessel functions" [Phys. Plasmas '''14''', 092103 (2007)]
 | journal = [[Physics of Plasmas]] | volume = 15 | page = 024701 | year = 2008 | doi = 10.1063/1.2839769
 | issue = 2}}
</ref><ref>
{{cite journal
 | first1 = Hong | last1 = Qin | first2 = Cynthia K. | last2 = Phillips | author2-link = Cynthia Kieras Phillips | first3 = Ronald C. | last3 = Davidson
 | title = Response to "Comment on 'A new derivation of the plasma susceptibility tensor for a hot magnetized plasma without infinite sums of products of Bessel functions'" [Phys. Plasmas 15, 024701 (2008)]

</ref>
